text:
jordan: Heads up — after the 02:00 UTC BMC roll in eu1-rack-07 we're seeing a provisioning stall. Multiple GPU nodes fail to finish PXE and go into a bootloop. OOB shows repeated 'ledger reset' and the BMC LED TTL decrements to 0 within ~30s.

maria: rack id and sample host?

jordan: eu1-rack-07. example host: gpu-eu1-0723. Logs attached from iLO show: `BMC: ledger_reset reason=fw-update ttl=30ms` then `oob-led: ttl=0, notifying hostwatch`

kai: sounds like the fw landed but the BMC's persistent NVRAM cleared the LED/ttl counters and that trips our provisioning watchdog. watchdog then shuts vPDUs -> node reboots -> PXE never re-registers.

maria: can we confirm if this is limited to rack-07 or cross-rack? any pattern by PSU or temp?

jordan: so far only rack-07 and all affected chassis are in PSU bank B. Temp probes look normal but one probe reading is intermittently 2-3C below expected during the flash window.

sre-bot: incident#create 2026-03-18T02:12Z - impact: 12 nodes stuck, capacity loss ~1.2% in eu1. assigned: @kai @ops_lead

ops_lead: immediate plan — stop remaining BMC roll in eu1, canary rollback to previous fw on rack-07, and hold other racks. Kai, can you try a soft power cycle on two affected nodes and force BMC to reapply nvram defaults? We need to avoid full rack power cycle if possible.

kai: running soft power cycle + kexec for gpu-eu1-0723 now. command:```ssh admin@gpu-eu1-0723 'ipmitool chassis power cycle'```

maria: if soft cycle fails we should run the fast rollback: replace fw image with fw-v1.8.2 (the pre-roll). I'll coordinate with fw-team for signed image and checksum.

jordan: note: provisioning-runbook step 4 currently assumes LED TTL persists across reboots — we'll add a guard to not gate provisioning on LED TTL until the BMC nvram is validated. small runbook change to avoid future false-positive stalls.

ops_lead: temporary mitigation: route new provisioning jobs away from eu1 to eu3 for the next 90 minutes to maintain SLAs. Maria, estimate cost delta for cross-region (egress + spot migration) so finance is aware.

maria: rough estimate: +$120/hr if we sustain 12 nodes in eu3 for an hour due to spot delta and temporary transfer. I'll log a cost ticket.

kai: update: soft cycles succeeded on 2/3 test nodes, BMC reloaded nvram, LED TTL stayed stable, nodes rejoined pxeservice. rolling continue with canary rollback on remaining 10 nodes now.

jordan: good — pausing global rollout. fw-team, please investigate why nvram ledger cleared when the temperature probe reads slightly lower. Also add BMC-side retry for nvram commit.

ops_lead: capture action items: [1] pause eu1 rollout (done), [2] canary rollback rack-07 (in progress), [3] runbook change: don't gate provisioning on oob-led ttl, [4] fw-team root cause on nvram clear & temp probe correlation, [5] cost ticket for eu1->eu3 spill. assign owners and ETA 3h.

jordan: I'll post a short customer-facing note once we're stable. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
